subject.title: feat: bound transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw adopt durable transcript generations plus public raw and visible bounded-cursor APIs as a cross-plugin foundation, rather than limit the active-memory optimization to a narrower owner-approved seam?
rationale: The choice sets a persistent storage contract and public Plugin SDK behavior that future plugins and stacked follow-ups will depend on; code review cannot decide the long-term API and upgrade commitment.

options.title: Approve the foundation deliberately
options.body: Confirm that durable generation state and both cursor APIs are desired supported contracts, then require an additive-schema migration design and explicit compatibility coverage.

options.title: Pause and narrow the proposal
options.body: Defer the new public cursor contract until a maintainer sponsors it, retaining only an owner-approved bounded-read path if active-memory needs an immediate optimization.

recommendation.title: Pause and narrow the proposal
recommendation.body: Defer the new public cursor contract until a maintainer sponsors it, retaining only an owner-approved bounded-read path if active-memory needs an immediate optimization.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed design and stacked follow-up rationale in the available branch history; a repository owner should make the final product decision.
